notes.title: CTHULHU DETECTIVE Dev Log: Progress Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,  CTHULHU DETECTIVE—coming at you with a fresh progress update!


[p align="start"]The main story and levels are pretty much wrapped up, and we’re now diving deep into the final polish, optimization, and QA phase. 🔧


[p align="start"]Here’s some juicy info for you—dig in:

 4 core cases | 16+ hours of gameplay | fully immersive mystery world!

20+ romanceable characters

 3 main endings + 20+ branch endings (yes, there’s New Game+ too 😉)

40+ achievements (where my achievement hunters at?!)

 Upgraded in-depth deduction gameplay—bring your brain!


[p align="start"]But wait, there’s more! We’re also cooking up some fun little features to make your playthrough even more entertaining… maybe even a way to mess with the NPCs? 👀 We’ll share more once things are solid—no empty promises!


[p align="start"]As for the big question—the release date—we’ll have a clear answer very soon. Stay tuned!
[p align="start"]Thanks so much for your ongoing support, everyone. Can’t wait to share the game with you all very soon!
